a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreement almost certainly kills us both. The generator needs 2 rounds to reach 8, and we'd likely survive only one storm check in five. So I plan to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you'd rather propose a different split, say so, but 2+2 saves no one.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. With an 80% storm chance each round, waiting for 8 most likely meant neither of us survives. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4, and I won't take any more cells.
